rows.text: Krenko, Mob Boss leads this separate Bracket 4 copy of Krenko-Combo. The original Bracket 3 list is unchanged. The upgrade trades slow anthems, two-mana rocks and tapped utility lands for moxen, rituals, reliable haste and recovery. Build toward a protected turn-four-or-later win; this is a construction target, not a measured win percentage.

rows.name: Krenko, Mob Boss
rows.text: Count every Goblin you control, including Krenko, before activating. A ready Krenko with two supporting Goblins produces three more immediately; an isolated Krenko is much less explosive.

rows.name: Samut, Hazoret's Champion
rows.text: Two-mana haste for every creature, including Krenko and the non-Goblin Marvin. Deploy it before committing Krenko when you intend to activate immediately.

rows.name: Goblin Chieftain
rows.text: Another Goblin haste source that also turns the fair attack into pressure. Unlike Samut, its haste applies only to Goblins.

rows.name: Thousand-Year Elixir
rows.text: Lets newly arrived creatures use tap abilities as though they had haste, then pays one and taps to untap Krenko. It does not actually grant haste for attacking.

rows.name: Lightning Greaves
rows.text: Equip for zero to protect a ready commander. Move the Greaves off before attaching Staff or Mantle or targeting Krenko with another effect; shroud stops your own targeting too.

rows.name: Skirk Prospector
rows.text: Converts spare Goblins into the red needed for tutors, haste and loops. Leave the required Goblin count and sacrifice outlet alive rather than cashing out the whole board early.

rows.name: Krenko, Mob Boss + Thornbite Staff + Skirk Prospector
rows.text: Attach Staff to Krenko, normally paying its four-mana equip; Krenko is not a Shaman that gets the automatic attachment. Activate Krenko, sacrifice one new Goblin to Prospector, and Staff's death trigger untaps Krenko. With Krenko and Prospector already present each pass makes at least two Goblins, so repeat for arbitrary bodies and red mana. Finish with Bombardment, Kreat, Mons or Purphoros.

rows.name: Krenko, Mob Boss + Thornbite Staff + Ashnod's Altar
rows.text: Altar is the second free sacrifice engine. Creature deaths still untap the equipped commander; the resulting colorless mana pays generic costs, not red pips.

rows.name: Krenko, Mob Boss + Umbral Mantle + Skirk Prospector
rows.text: With at least four Goblins counted by Krenko, make tokens and sacrifice three for Mantle's untap cost. Each loop leaves an extra Goblin. Exactly three counted Goblins only breaks even on bodies.

rows.name: Marvin, Murderous Mimic
rows.text: Copies other creatures' activated abilities, including Krenko's, but does not copy haste. Use Samut or Elixir before trying a fresh Marvin. It remains a Toy rather than another counted Goblin.

rows.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Zealous Conscripts
rows.text: Kiki copies Conscripts; the token's entry untaps Kiki. Repeat for arbitrary hasty attackers, or sacrifice tokens to Bombardment. Combat needs an available combat step and a clear damage path.

rows.name: General Kreat, the Boltbringer
rows.text: Repeated creature entries drain every opponent, so a token loop becomes a same-turn noncombat kill instead of waiting to untap.

rows.name: Purphoros, God of the Forge
rows.text: Another every-opponent token-entry payoff. It need not be a creature for that trigger to work.

rows.name: Pashalik Mons
rows.text: Goblin deaths deal one damage to any target. Prospector and Bombardment make the death trigger dependable rather than waiting for combat.

rows.name: Howlsquad Heavy
rows.text: Gives other Goblins haste and adds a body at combat. Its huge mana ability needs max speed; it is not immediately available just because Heavy entered.

rows.name: Rundvelt Hordemaster + Skullclamp
rows.text: Hordemaster supplies playable Goblins after deaths; Clamp turns disposable creatures into cards; a toughness-boosting lord can prevent it killing a token by itself, so use a sacrifice outlet when needed. Do not claim the Hordemaster's exiled cards go to hand.

rows.name: Goblin Engineer + Goblin Welder
rows.text: Engineer can put Staff, Mantle or another artifact in the graveyard. Welder trades a battlefield artifact for it after becoming ready; protect both targets until resolution. Engineer's own return ability is limited to mana value three or less.

rows.name: Gamble + Underworld Breach
rows.text: Gamble can find the missing piece, and Breach makes a discarded piece recoverable if enough other graveyard cards remain. Escape exiles three other cards each time; this is finite recovery, not a free permanent loop.

rows.name: Chrome Mox + Mox Diamond + Mox Opal
rows.text: Moxen accelerate the commander turn. Chrome consumes a colored nonartifact card, Diamond consumes a land, and Opal needs three artifacts. An opener whose acceleration cannot turn on is not fast.

rows.name: Mana Vault + Jeska's Will
rows.text: Vault supplies generic mana for Krenko and equipment; it does not pay red pips. With Krenko present Will can use both modes. Keep enough red sources to cast the cards it exposes.

rows.name: Rite of Flame + Desperate Ritual + Seething Song
rows.text: Bridge the mana gap into a haste-plus-commander or tutor-plus-combo turn. Cast these to execute a plan, not merely to add storm while losing cards.

rows.name: Brightstone Ritual + Battle Hymn
rows.text: Bodies become burst mana. Count actual Goblins for Brightstone and all your creatures for Hymn; they are poor recovery cards on an empty battlefield.

rows.name: Goblin Cratermaker + Gempalm Incinerator
rows.text: Matron-accessible interaction. Cratermaker sacrifices to kill a small creature or a colorless nonland permanent. Cycling Incinerator draws toward a stacked pile and can remove a creature using the actual Goblin count.

guide.title: Recruiter piles and independent Goblin wins

rows.name: Goblin Matron -> Goblin Recruiter
rows.text: Matron puts Recruiter into hand; budget the second cast. Find the engine rather than another anthem when a protected combo is available.

rows.name: Imperial Recruiter -> Goblin Recruiter
rows.text: Recruiter has power one and is a legal target. Imperial also finds Snoop, Prospector, Courier or Kiki when that is the missing piece.

rows.name: Goblin Recruiter + Goblin Ringleader
rows.text: For a four-card refill, put Ringleader first, then Snoop, Courier, Prospector and Squelcher. Draw Ringleader, cast it, and take those four Goblins. Put Kiki immediately below the four if assembling Snoop next. Leave Fanatic in the library.

rows.name: Goblin Recruiter + Muxus, Goblin Grandee
rows.text: A six-hit deployment is Warchief, Kiki, Crafter, Prospector, Snoop and Fanatic. All six are Goblin creatures with mana value five or less. Crafter can champion the Recruiter already in play; Kiki/Crafter/Prospector then supplies the immediate kill. Cast Muxus from the command zone in its own deck, or have it in hand in the others.

Complete fetches before Recruiter resolves. Drawing, milling or shuffling afterward changes the planned top cards. A pile is not a guarantee if a needed piece is already in hand or the graveyard; use a different route rather than pretending it is still in the library.

rows.name: Conspicuous Snoop + Torch Courier
rows.text: The direct pile is Snoop on top to draw, followed by Courier and Kiki. After drawing and casting Snoop, cast Courier from the revealed top and sacrifice it to give Snoop haste. Kiki must now remain on top, not in hand or on the battlefield.

rows.name: Conspicuous Snoop + Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker
rows.text: With Kiki revealed, tap the hasty Snoop to copy itself. Each new Snoop token has haste and the same copy ability. Use the newest untapped copy repeatedly to make as many Snoops as needed.

rows.name: Conspicuous Snoop + Goblin Recruiter + Mogg Fanatic
rows.text: Use the last Snoop's copied Kiki ability to copy the original Recruiter. The token Recruiter puts Fanatic on top. Every Snoop now gains Fanatic's sacrifice-for-one-damage ability. Sacrifice enough Snoops to kill all three opponents. Stack every needed sacrifice before resolving other effects that change the library top. Keep Recruiter on the battlefield until that final copy; having Fanatic in hand does not grant its ability.

rows.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Lightning Crafter + Skirk Prospector
rows.text: Copy Crafter, champion Kiki with the new hasty copy, tap that copy for three damage, then sacrifice it to Prospector. Kiki returns untapped with haste. Repeat for lethal damage and red mana. The original Crafter must champion a different Goblin or Shaman first; do not accidentally exile the only required outlet.

rows.name: Goblin Warchief
rows.text: Supplies haste and reduces only generic costs of Goblin spells. It makes Muxus cheaper, but cannot reduce Snoop's two red pips or Kiki's three red pips.

rows.name: Hexing Squelcher
rows.text: Makes spells uncounterable and taxes targeting of your other creatures with life. This does not stop removal, exile, sacrifice, triggered counters to abilities, or an opponent paying the ward cost.

rows.name: Goblin Bombardment
rows.text: Converts assembled tokens into damage without combat or haste. It is also a free outlet for Crafter copies, replacing Prospector's mana with an additional damage per loop.

Keep two or three usable lands, functioning acceleration, and either early Goblins plus haste or a tutor-led combo. Mulligan hands made only of payoffs and equipment. City of Traitors provides a burst but sacrifices when you play another land; use it after the lands you need to keep. Cavern protects one chosen creature type, not equipment or rituals.

rows.name: Deflecting Swat + Pyroblast + Red Elemental Blast
rows.text: Save protection for the spell or removal effect that breaks the winning line. Swat changes targets; it does not counter a sweeper. A blue permanent can be destroyed by a Blast before the combo starts.

rows.name: Goblin Chirurgeon
rows.text: Sacrifice a spare Goblin to regenerate a creature before a destruction effect resolves. Regeneration does not stop exile or sacrifice and taps the regenerated creature; account for that if it is the only ready engine.

When the table represents removal, establish an outlet and protection before exposing every piece. Against creature-activation hate, clear the hate first or rebuild with a noncreature token payoff. This Bracket 4 version has no Bracket 3 turn-six waiting rule; agree on the faster game before shuffling.
